home.aboutIntro: Ward No. 16 is one of the 32 administrative wards of Kathmandu Metropolitan City, located in Kathmandu, Nepal. The ward encompasses the Balaju area and its surrounding localities, reflecting a rich blend of urban development, community life, and cultural heritage. It is home to historically and culturally significant sites such as {sites}, which preserve important religious traditions, local stories, and cultural practices. Beyond its historical significance, Ward No. 16 represents a living community where heritage, identity, and modern urban life coexist.
